# Camp Landau

> Camp Landau is a summer camp in Ramat Beit Shemesh, Israel, for English-speaking boys finishing grades 1 to 8. It describes itself as Beit Shemesh's #1 summer camp: days packed with sports, swimming, trips, Ruach, games, shtick and special surprises, run by Gishmak counselors.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: English-speaking boys finishing 1st through 8th grade
- Where: Sha'alei Torah, Nachal Sorek 16, Ramat Beit Shemesh, Israel
- Camp Director: Rabbi Yehoshua Landau, 02-999-6341 or 052-760-0897
- Also reachable: Mordy Landau, 058-675-8475
- Email: Camp@Camp-Landau.com
- Activities: sports (basketball, soccer, relay races, camp-wide tournaments), swimming, day trips across Eretz Yisrael (boats, amusement parks), Ruach (singing and dancing), games (trivia, scavenger hunts, competition days), shtick (performers, magic shows, game shows) and special surprises
- Music: Camp Landau has its own original camp songs, on Spotify and 24six
- STG, See the Good: a daily Dan L'chaf Zechus program. Campers watch a clip of someone doing something that looks wrong, work on judging favorably, then see what was really going on
